subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: What evidence and repair policy should OpenClaw require before relinking a Dashboard session key to a preserved transcript or trajectory file?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the preserved file from corrupted private state can misattach history, so automation should not choose the permanent recovery policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Conservative doctor relink
options.body: Add a doctor/diagnostic repair that relinks only when a redacted fixture and unambiguous metadata/header/trajectory evidence prove the target file.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Report suspected mismatches and orphan candidates without mutating sessions.json until the operator confirms the recovery target manually.

options.title: Heuristic relink
options.body: Allow best-effort content or timestamp matching to repair more cases while accepting a higher risk of attaching the wrong history.

recommendation.title: Conservative doctor relink
recommendation.body: Add a doctor/diagnostic repair that relinks only when a redacted fixture and unambiguous metadata/header/trajectory evidence prove the target file.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate for session-history repair policy among the current likely owners and recent adjacent state-migration work.
